title: RNA structure at nucleotide resolution
study: Mustoe et al., 2018 · rpsT · in-cell SHAPE
description: The 432-nucleotide rpsT transcript with 341 measured reactivities and its accompanying secondary-structure model. Original-study data are redistributed in the ShaKer repository; missing reactivities remain missing.
coordinateSystem: 1-based transcript index; no chromosome mapping asserted
processing: Select rpsT_5 by exact transcript ID. Preserve normalized in-cell reactivity values; omit NA measurements. Parse parentheses in accompanying incell.dbn to pair partners. Pairing is a supplied model, not experimentally proven individual base pairs. No new folding calculation.
limits: Structure arcs are the redistributed supplied model, not direct measurements of each base pair.
SHAPE reactivity describes local chemical accessibility; it is not base-pair probability.
Missing measurements are excluded, not replaced with zero.
This is one transcript from the published 194-transcript dataset.
